formula: dx = cx[0] + cx[1]*(x - 500)/500 + cx[2]*(y - 500)/500; dy likewise with cy (x, y = 0-based detector pixel; evaluated as A @ c with A = [1, (x-500)/500, (y-500)/500])
meaning: a 4QPM pane pixel (x, y) sees the sky that the imager distortion solution (the cal WCS) assigns to (x + dx, y + dy)
source: fullframe_preview.fit_regions on pane stars of every GC F770W frame (region_models.npy)
